text: Figure 12.1: Exemplary vehicle software update scenario Update and Configuration Management allows to install and update software on the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform and AUTOSAR Classic Platform. For the AU- TOSAR Adaptive Platform, Update and Configuration Management also al- lows to remove software. The software packages can be received either from a Di- agnostic Client or from a specific Backend System for over-the-air updates. In a vehicle, one Adaptive Application takes the role of a master that controls the update process in the vehicle and distributes individual software packages to the Ma- chines and ECUs within a vehicle.
